M01.reason: Legality for writes becomes AND instead of OR: aligned full-strobe writes only legal if pwrite=0 (never), reads with any strobe are illegal; legal requests get PSLVERR locally instead of a TL-UL request.

M02.reason: a_valid is set to 1 instead of cleared on a_accept, so a_valid is not dropped after the handshake and the request is repeated.

M03.reason: On local error PREADY is not raised, so the illegal transfer has no completion in the first Access cycle.

M04.reason: State condition inverted: responses in WAIT are no longer counted, and orphan d_valid in IDLE/REQ without accept would be counted.

M05.reason: PSLVERR is set to 1 in idle/non-completion cycles, so PSLVERR is high without PREADY.

M06.reason: Local-error branch condition inverted: illegal Setup gets no local error, while every other cycle loads pready/pslverr=1 and prdata=0.

M07.reason: w_resp_done uses OR, so orphan i_resp_valid outside BUSY, or BUSY with no response, produces a spurious PREADY completion.

M08.reason: Source check inverted: a response with the correct source is flagged as error and a wrong source is accepted without error.

M09.reason: w_resp_done is true only outside BUSY, so a real response in BUSY gives no APB completion (transfer hangs).

M10.reason: AND with the state term becomes OR: any d_valid with d_ready counts as a response, so orphans produce a completion.

M11.reason: Error OR becomes AND on the source term: a wrong source alone no longer raises an error.

M12.reason: a_valid is not set at the Setup edge load, so no TL-UL request is launched and the transfer hangs.

M13.reason: In WAIT the FSM leaves to IDLE when there is no response and stays when there is one, so the single-outstanding-request tracking breaks and the FSM returns to IDLE early.

M14.reason: The opcode flop resets to 1 instead of 0, so o_tlul_a_opcode is 3'b100 during reset.

M15.reason: Local error completes with PSLVERR=0 instead of 1, so the illegal transfer is not flagged.

M16.reason: Load condition inverted to a non-IDLE TL-UL state, so a Setup launch in IDLE never loads the payload or a_valid.

M17.reason: PREADY resets to 1, so o_apb_pready is high during reset.

M18.reason: Reset branch inverted: the reset values are applied in normal operation and not in reset.

M19.reason: w_local_err uses OR, so any Setup (even legal) or any illegal-looking inputs yield a local error/PSLVERR.

M20.reason: Strobe comparison inverted: full-strobe writes are rejected and partial-strobe writes are accepted as legal.

M21.reason: Load uses OR: the channel A flops load whenever the TL-UL FSM is IDLE, even without a launch, so a_valid is raised without a legal Setup.

M22.reason: OR changed to AND: a_accept and WAIT are never both true, so no response is ever counted.

M23.reason: d_ready is held at 0 after reset, so no response is ever accepted.

M24.reason: Reset branch inverted on the payload flops: they are cleared during operation and not reset (and load never happens), so opcode/address/data are wrong.

M25.reason: a_valid resets to 1, so o_tlul_a_valid is high during reset.

M26.reason: On response completion PREADY is not set, so the APB transfer never completes.

M27.reason: Accept is true outside REQ, so a_valid and FSM progress follow a_ready in the wrong states and the request is not accepted correctly in REQ.

M28.reason: PREADY stays 1 in non-completion cycles, so it is not a one-cycle pulse and is high outside an Access phase.

M29.reason: FSM goes to DONE when there is no local error and not launch, and stays IDLE on an illegal Setup; the FSM sequencing disagrees with PREADY.

M30.reason: Setup detection becomes (IDLE && psel) || !penable, so Setup is recognised without psel or during Access.

M31.reason: Accept uses OR: a_valid drops or a response counts when a_ready is high in any state or in REQ without a_ready, so handshake tracking is wrong.

M32.reason: a_valid is set when load is not asserted instead of on load, so the request is not launched at Setup and a_valid is raised spuriously.

M33.reason: d_ready resets to 1, so o_tlul_d_ready is high during reset.

M34.reason: PSLVERR resets to 1 without PREADY, so it is high during reset.

M35.reason: APB FSM reset branch inverted: it is forced to IDLE in operation and not reset, so transfers never reach BUSY/DONE correctly.

M36.reason: Setup detection becomes IDLE || (psel && !penable), so Setup is recognised in every IDLE cycle regardless of psel/penable.
